h1: Empowering Tuvalu With Autonomous 24/7 Cloud AI
sub: Set up personal AI agents that operate inside dedicated cloud computers. They research, code, browse the web, and run routine workflows even when your phone or satellite link disconnects.
audience: Public administrators, regional fisheries researchers, maritime logistics managers, remote Pacific consultants, and Funafuti small enterprise owners.
manifesto: In an isolated ocean nation, connectivity should never limit your ambition. Ceyo keeps autonomous cloud computers working uninterrupted around the clock, bridging Funafuti to global markets, regional development grants, and worldwide trade continuously.

uses.d: Command an autonomous browser agent to monitor maritime arrivals at Funafuti Port, track regional shipping schedules, and compile daily freight updates into Google Sheets.
Direct your research bot to gather multilateral Pacific climate fund criteria, review documentation, and generate structured draft proposals in shared workspaces.
Let your cloud computer process financial reconciliations and data pipelines overnight, ensuring workflows never stop if local power or satellite broadband fluctuates.
Coordinate local field assessments across outer islands by gathering field notes, photos, and voice notes into a specialized multi-bot Telegram group chat.
Use the coding agent to deploy web portals, manage international client inquiries, and reconcile cross-border crypto and invoice transactions automatically.
Schedule autonomous agents to summarize international Pacific community bulletins, ministerial papers, and statistical tables into concise executive briefs every morning.

steps.d: Select your plan and activate a dedicated 24/7 virtual computer in seconds with your free trial.
Link your favorite apps like Google Workspace, Notion, or Telegram to collaborate with your bot anywhere.
Assign complex tasks, from continuous web monitoring to software development, and let your agents handle the rest.

chapters.d: While Funafuti awakens, your bot has already pulled weather forecasts, tide tables, and Pacific shipping logs into a morning brief. You review the summary on Telegram before heading out.

Your agent accesses international aid portals via its cloud browser, extracts compliance checklists, and organizes documents in Notion. It coordinates citations without touching your local device's memory.
Inside your team Telegram chat, the researcher agent and coding agent collaborate to debug an internal reporting database. They deploy the fix directly inside their cloud sandbox.

You switch off your laptop and mobile phone to conserve battery during island power management. High above in the cloud, your agents continue running scheduled routines and monitoring feeds all night.

faq.q: How do Ceyo pricing and the free trial work in Tuvalu?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three simple tiers: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with an unrestricted 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens daily; your linked card is charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Does Ceyo stay running if Funafuti loses internet connectivity?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot runs inside its own isolated cloud computer in secure data centers, not on your local device. Even if your home broadband drops or your phone is turned off, your agents continue browsing, coding, and executing tasks uninterrupted.

faq.q: What languages can I use to communicate with my bots?
faq.a: You can communicate fluently in English, Tuvaluan, and dozens of other world languages. Your bots understand nuances across technical documentation, regional dialects, and international communications effortlessly.

faq.q: Can I control my Ceyo agents directly through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can chat with your personal bot one-on-one or add multiple bot specialists into a Telegram group chat. They can collaborate together, share memory, respond to voice notes, and notify you when a long-running task completes.

faq.q: What applications can my AI agent connect to?
faq.a: Ceyo connects with over 1,000 popular cloud tools including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Google Calendar, and standard CRMs. It also features a built-in crypto wallet and an autonomous web browser to interact with virtually any online service.
